description: Domain glossary for the Nords Spatial Engine. This resource provides semantic context for every core concept, field, and relationship in the system.

Nord.definition: A node card in the spatial graph. Represents any domain entity — a task, person, bug, milestone, artifact, etc.
Nord.properties: Each nord has a title, description, 2D canvas position (position_x, position_y), visual scale, and a dynamic JSONB properties bag whose schema is defined by its NordType.
Nord.relationships: Connected to other nords via Connections. Belongs to a Project.

Connection.definition: A typed edge (relationship) between two Nords. Represents any relationship — 'blocks', 'depends on', 'reports to', etc.
Connection.properties: Carries a spectrum position (distance_x, distance_y), direction, sort_order, and a dynamic JSONB properties bag.
Connection.key_insight: The distance_x value (0.0–1.0) maps to the ConnectionType's x_stage_labels, determining which board column the connected nord appears in.

NordType.definition: A schema definition for a category of Nords. Defines the property columns, icon, accent color, and visual behavior.
NordType.analogy: Similar to a database table definition — it defines what columns (properties) nords of this type have.

ConnectionType.definition: A schema definition for a category of relationships. Defines stage labels, stroke style, direction rules, and property columns.

key_fields.x_stage_labels: Ordered labels for the horizontal spectrum axis (e.g., ['To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done']). Each connection's distance_x maps to a position along these labels.
key_fields.stroke_style: Visual line rendering: solid, dashed, or dotted.
key_fields.default_direction: The default arrow direction for new connections of this type.

Project.definition: A container for a complete graph — all nords, connections, types, and personas within a workspace.

key_fields.purpose: A free-text description of why this project exists. Used as context for AI persona interactions.
key_fields.mcp_enabled: Whether this project is exposed to external AI tools via the Model Context Protocol.
key_fields.mcp_mutable: Whether MCP integrations can modify graph data (experimental).

Persona.definition: An AI lens configuration. Personas weight different ConnectionTypes differently, prioritizing some relationships and suppressing others.

components.mental_models: Up to 5 focus areas with titles and detailed descriptions. Used as system prompt context for AI interactions.
components.category_weights: Per-ConnectionType relevance weights (-100 to +100). Controls how strongly each relationship type influences the persona's view.

Persona.example: An 'Engineering Lead' persona might weight 'Blocks' at +80 and 'References' at -20, focusing attention on blockers while downplaying informational links.

Snapshot.definition: An immutable capture of the entire graph state at a point in time. Includes all nords, connections, types, and positions.
Snapshot.use_case: Version control for graph state — compare 'before refactor' vs 'after refactor'.

Account.definition: A billing entity that owns one or more Organizations. Tracks API usage for cost attribution.
Account.billing_model: Usage-based: each account pays its proportional share of GCP infrastructure costs + 20% margin.

Organization.definition: A logical grouping of users and projects. Belongs to an Account. Currently in single-user mode with a static placeholder org.

distance_x.meaning: Horizontal spectrum position along the ConnectionType's x_stage_labels. 0.0 = first stage, 1.0 = last stage.
distance_x.used_by: Board view column placement, graph edge rendering.

distance_y.meaning: Vertical axis position. Reserved for future quadrant mode. Currently unused in board view.

position_x.meaning: Horizontal canvas position in normalized coordinates. Not bounded to 0–1 — can be negative.

position_y.meaning: Vertical canvas position in normalized coordinates.

scale.meaning: Visual size multiplier for the nord card. Can be driven by a property value via NordType.scale_property.

properties.meaning: Dynamic key-value store on nords and connections. Keys correspond to PropertySchema names defined on the entity's type.

values.user: Admin-set context property. Filled when creating a nord instance. Defines the node's identity on the knowledge graph. Read-only to the AI.
values.mcp: AI-collected knowledge property. Populated during MCP sessions via ethnographic conversation. Forms the structured knowledge graph data. Required MCP properties drive goal completion. Template values serve as examples for the AI.

source.meaning: Distinguishes between admin context and AI-collectible structured data on PropertySchema. MCP properties appear in the planning_queue, are bindable to goals, and are shared by property name across session nords.
source.used_by: Horizon planning_queue, goal property bindings, ManageTypes panel

properties_schema.meaning: Column definitions for the properties JSONB bag. Each entry defines a name, data type, validation rules, and UI configuration.
properties_schema.analogy: Like ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN — it defines what data the properties bag can hold.

sort_order.meaning: Display order within a list or within a board column. Lower values appear first.
sort_order.used_by: Type lists, persona lists, within-column card ordering.

accent_hue.meaning: HSL hue value for the persona's accent color. Used for visual distinction in the UI.

accent_color.meaning: Visual accent color for types. Displayed on cards, edges, and UI chrome.

weight.meaning: Persona category weight. Positive = prioritize this relationship type, negative = suppress it, zero = neutral.

relationships.Account → Organization: One-to-many. An account can own multiple orgs.
relationships.Organization → Project: One-to-many. An org contains multiple projects.
relationships.Project → NordType: Many-to-many via project_types. Types can be shared across projects.
relationships.Project → Nord: One-to-many. Nords belong to exactly one project.
relationships.Project → Connection: One-to-many. Connections belong to exactly one project.
relationships.Nord → NordType: Many-to-one. Each nord has exactly one type.
relationships.Connection → ConnectionType: Many-to-one. Each connection has exactly one type.
relationships.Connection → Nord (source): Many-to-one. The 'from' side of the edge.
relationships.Connection → Nord (target): Many-to-one. The 'to' side of the edge.
relationships.Persona → CategoryWeight: One-to-many. One weight per ConnectionType per persona.
